item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 25/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A hot southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be relatively humid over the region with mist patches. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China later on Friday to early Saturday. There will be a few showers over the region and there may be thunderstorms over inland areas. Under the persistent influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be cool over Guangdong during the weekend to early next week.

Temp range: 21 - 28 C
